# Functions
```{r functions, include = FALSE}
# convert power in uV^2 to dB
uV2_to_dB <- function(uV2){
  dB <- 10*log10(uV2)
}

# outlier detection of lmer models
outlier_modelresiduals <- function(df, model_residuals, var2clean){
  # z-score residuals
  residuals_z <- scale(model_residuals)[,1]
  # new column name
  newcolname <- paste0(var2clean,"_clean")
  # outlier variables to NA
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      !!newcolname := if_else(
        abs(residuals_z)>2 | is.na(residuals_z),
        NA,
        .data[[var2clean]])
    )
  # remove outlier rows
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(newcolname)))
  return(df)
}

# rename only the non-merge columns
rename_data_cols <- function(df, suffix) {
  data_cols <- setdiff(names(df), merge_cols)
  names(df)[names(df) %in% data_cols] <- paste0(data_cols, "_", suffix)
  df
}

# extract ROI name from column name
roi_from_name <- function(x) {
  str_extract(x,"(?<=sipfc\\.)[^_]+")
}

# extract Metabolite from column name
metabolite_from_name <- function(x) {
  str_extract(x,"(?<=_)[^_]+(?=(_|$))")
}
```

```{r load data, include=FALSE}
                "Accuracy","AvgLatCor","CVLatCor","AvgLatErrCor","CVLatErrCor",
                "NumCor","NumErrCor","NumIncor","NumDrop","Total","Viable")

clusterpower_prow_df <- rename_data_cols(clusterpower_prow_df, "prow")
# combine cluster power frow and prow

# cluster description data frames

clusters_prow_df <- read.csv("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/ersp_itc_clusterinfo_avgtrl_prow_20260615.csv")
clusters_frow_df$row <- as.factor('frow')
clusters_prow_df$row <- as.factor('prow')
clusters_df <- rbind(clusters_frow_df, clusters_prow_df)

# broadband spontaneous and evoked power
broadband_frow_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/broadband_sponevo_frow_20260508.csv')
broadband_prow_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/broadband_sponevo_prow_20260615.csv')
# renamed only non-merge columns
broadband_frow_df <- rename_data_cols(broadband_frow_df,"frow")
broadband_prow_df <- rename_data_cols(broadband_prow_df,"prow")
# merge broadband dataframes
broadband_df <- merge(broadband_frow_df, broadband_prow_df, by = merge_cols)

# merge broadband and ersp data frames
sponevo_ersp_df <- merge(clusterpower_df,broadband_df, by = merge_cols)

# make lunaid a factor
sponevo_ersp_df$lunaid <- as.factor(sponevo_ersp_df$lunaid)

# add visit number
sponevo_ersp_df <- sponevo_ersp_df %>%
  group_by(lunaid) %>%
  mutate(visit = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# calculate correct response rate
sponevo_ersp_df$CorRate <- sponevo_ersp_df$NumCor / (sponevo_ersp_df$NumCor +
                                                               sponevo_ersp_df$NumErrCor)

# columns to no convert to dB
cols_no_convert <- c("lunaid","eeg_date","eeg_age","sex",
                     "PercentErrCor","AvgLatCor","CVLatCor",
                     "AvgLatErrCor","CVLatErrCor","NumCor",
                     "NumErrCor","NumDrop","NumIncor","Total",
                     "Viable","visit","CorRate","Accuracy","CorRate")

# columns to convert to dB
cols_to_convert <- sponevo_ersp_df %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("power"), -all_of(cols_no_convert)) %>%
  names()

# convert power values from uV^2 to dB
sponevo_ersp_df_dB <- sponevo_ersp_df %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(cols_to_convert),
      .fns = ~ uV2_to_dB(.x),
      .names = "{.col}_dB"
    )
  )

# make sure dB matrix lunaid is factor
sponevo_ersp_df_dB$lunaid <- factor(sponevo_ersp_df_dB$lunaid, levels = levels(sponevo_ersp_df_dB$lunaid))

  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric), -all_of(cols_no_trans)) %>%
  names()
merged7t_glugaba <- merged7t_glugaba %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(cols_to_trans),
      .fns = ~ sqrt(.x),
      .names = "{.col}_sqrt"
    )
  )
```

# Behavior
## Age + Sex
```{r behavior age effects, echo = FALSE}
# variables to loop over
behavs <- c("CorRate","CVLatCor","AvgLatCor")

for (b in behavs){
  # define temporary data frame
  temp_df <- data.frame(
    behav = main_df_viable[[b]],
    lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
    eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
    invage = main_df_viable$invage,
    eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
    sex = main_df_viable$sex
  )
  # --- Inverse Age ---
  # lm model with no random effects
  lm_model <- lm(behav ~ invage + sex,
                 data = temp_df,
                 na.action = na.exclude)
  clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df, 
                                     residuals(lm_model),
                                     "lunaid")
  lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(behav ~ invage + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                               data = clean_df,
                               na.action = na.exclude)
  # print summary
  lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
  print(b)
  print(lmer_summary)
  
  # --- Linear Age ---
  # lm model with no random effects
  lm_model_linage <- lm(behav ~ eeg_age + sex,
                 data = temp_df,
                 na.action = na.exclude)
  clean_df_linage <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df, 
                                     residuals(lm_model_linage),
                                     "lunaid")
  lmer_model_linage <- lmerTest::lmer(behav ~ eeg_age + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                               data = clean_df_linage,
                               na.action = na.exclude)
  # print AICs
  print(paste("AIC (inverse age):",round(AIC(lmer_model),2)))
  print(paste("AIC (linear age):",round(AIC(lmer_model_linage),2)))
  
  # bundle of variables to save
  model_bundle <- list(
    model = lmer_model,
    coefs = as.data.frame(coef(lmer_summary)),
    cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
    origdata = lm_model$model,
    AIC_invage = AIC(lmer_model),
    AIC_linage = AIC(lmer_model_linage),
    BIC_invage = BIC(lmer_model),
    BIC_linage = BIC(lmer_model_linage)
  )
  # save results
  savename <- paste0("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/R/",b,"_Age_Effects.rds")
  saveRDS(model_bundle, file = savename)
  
}

```

```{r}
    eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
    invage = main_df_viable$invage,
    eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
    sex = main_df_viable$sex,
    age_cat = main_df_viable$age_cat,
    ASpower_frow = main_df_viable[[paste0("corAS_broadband_",p,"power_frow_dB")]],
    ASpower_prow = main_df_viable[[paste0("corAS_broadband_",p,"power_prow_dB")]]
    ) 
  # add condtion
  AStemp_df <- AStemp_df %>% mutate(
    condition = "AS"
  )
  # pivot longer around row
  AStemp_df_long <- pivot_longer(data = AStemp_df,
                                 cols = c("ASpower_frow",
                                          "ASpower_prow"),
                                 names_to = "row",
                                 values_to = "power")
  AStemp_df_long <- AStemp_df_long %>%
    mutate(
      row = ifelse(row == "ASpower_frow","frow",
                   ifelse(row == "ASpower_prow","prow",NA))
    )
  
  VGStemp_df <- data.frame(
    lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
    eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
    invage = main_df_viable$invage,
    eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
    sex = main_df_viable$sex,
    age_cat = main_df_viable$age_cat,
    VGSpower_frow = main_df_viable[[paste0("VGS_broadband_",p,"power_frow_dB")]],
    VGSpower_prow = main_df_viable[[paste0("VGS_broadband_",p,"power_prow_dB")]]
    ) 
  # add condtion
  VGStemp_df <- VGStemp_df %>% mutate(
    condition = "VGS"
  )
  # pivot longer around row
  VGStemp_df_long <- pivot_longer(data = VGStemp_df,
                                 cols = c("VGSpower_frow",
                                          "VGSpower_prow"),
                                 names_to = "row",
                                 values_to = "power")
  VGStemp_df_long <- VGStemp_df_long %>%
    mutate(
      row = ifelse(row == "VGSpower_frow","frow",
                   ifelse(row == "VGSpower_prow","prow",NA))
    )
  
  # combine AS and VGS data frames
  temp_df_long <- rbind(AStemp_df_long,VGStemp_df_long)
  temp_df_long <- temp_df_long %>%
    mutate(
      row = factor(row, levels = c("frow","prow")),
      condition = factor(condition, levels = c("AS","VGS")),
      sex = factor(sex, levels = c("F","M"))
    )
  
  # lm model
  lm_model <- lm(power ~ invage * condition *sex * row ,
                 data = temp_df_long,
                 na.action = na.exclude)
  clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df_long,
                                     residuals(lm_model),
                                     "lunaid")
  lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(power ~ 
                                 invage * condition * sex *
                                 row +
                                 (1|lunaid_clean),
                 data = clean_df,
                 na.action = na.exclude)
  lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
  print(p)
  print(lmer_summary)
  predict_df <- ggpredict(lmer_model, 
                          terms = c('invage[all]',
                                    'condition',
                                       'sex','row'))
  # bundle of variables to save
  model_bundle <- list(
    model = lmer_model,
    coefs = as.data.frame(coef(lmer_summary)),
    cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
    origdata = lm_model$model
  )
  # save results
  savename <- paste0("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/R/",p,"_AgeConditionRowSex_Effects.rds")
  saveRDS(model_bundle, file = savename)
}
```

## MRS effects
```{r spon/evo MRS effects, echo = FALSE}
# variables to loop over
powertypes <- c("spon","evo")
rows <- c("frow","prow")
tasks <- c("corAS","VGS")
mrs <-  c("sipfc.DLPFC_Glu_gamadj",
                 "sipfc.DLPFC_GABA_gamadj",
                 "sipfc.DLPFC_GluGaba_Asym_sqrt")

for (m in mrs){
  currmetabolite <- metabolite_from_name(m)
  suffix <- if (currmetabolite=="GluGaba"){
    "_Asym_sqrt"
    } else if (currmetabolite=="Glu" || currmetabolite=="GABA"){
      "_gamadj"
      }
  temp_df <- data.frame(
    lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
    sex = main_df_viable$sex,
    mrsi_age = main_df_viable$sess.age,
    invage = 1/main_df_viable$sess.age,
    viable = main_df_viable$Viable,
    r_mrs = main_df_viable[[paste0("sipfc.R", roi_from_name(m),"_",currmetabolite,suffix)]],
    l_mrs = main_df_viable[[paste0("sipfc.L", roi_from_name(m),"_",currmetabolite,suffix)]]
    )
  # pivot longer and make hemisphere a factor
  temp_df_long <- pivot_longer(temp_df, cols = c("r_mrs","l_mrs"),
                               names_to = "hemi",
                               values_to = "mrs")
  # lm model 
  lm_model <- lm(mrs ~ invage + hemi  + sex,
                 data = temp_df_long,
                 na.action = na.exclude)
  clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df_long,
                                     residuals(lm_model),
                                     "lunaid")
  lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(mrs ~ invage + hemi + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                               data = clean_df, 
                               na.action = na.exclude)
  # print summary
  lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
  lmer_coefs <- coef(lmer_summary)

  # is hemisphere significant?
  p_hemi <- lmer_coefs[["hemir_mrs","Pr(>|t|)"]]
  HEMI <- ifelse(p_hemi < 0.05, 1, 0)
  
  for (r in rows){
    for (t in tasks){
      for (p in powertypes){
        # If hemisphere is not significant average across hemisphere then run model
        if (HEMI==1){
          temp_df <- data.frame(
            lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
            eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
            eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
            sex = main_df_viable$sex,
            invage = main_df_viable$invage,
            viable = main_df_viable$Viable,
            r_mrs = main_df_viable[[paste0("sipfc.R", roi_from_name(m),"_",currmetabolite,suffix)]],
            l_mrs = main_df_viable[[paste0("sipfc.L", roi_from_name(m),"_",currmetabolite,suffix)]],
            power = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_broadband_",p,"power_",r,"_dB")]]
            )
          # pivot longer and make hemisphere a factor
          temp_df_long <- pivot_longer(temp_df, cols = c("r_mrs","l_mrs"),
                                       names_to = "hemi",
                                       values_to = "mrs")
          temp_df_long$hemi <- as.factor(temp_df_long$hemi)
          # lm model 
          lm_model <- lm(power ~ invage + hemi  + mrs + sex,
                         data = temp_df_long,
                         na.action = na.exclude)
          clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df_long,
                                             residuals(lm_model),
                                             "lunaid")
          lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(power ~ invage + hemi + mrs + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                                       data = clean_df, 
                                       na.action = na.exclude)
          # print summary
          lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
          lmer_coefs <- coef(lmer_summary)
          print(paste(m,p,t,r))
          print(lmer_coefs)
          
          # bundle and save results
          model_bundle <- list(
            model = lmer_model,
            coefs = as.data.frame(lmer_coefs),
            cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
            origdata = lm_model$model
          )
          savename <- paste0("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/R/",t, p, "Power", r, "_", currmetabolite,"_Effect.rds")
          saveRDS(model_bundle,savename)
          } else {
           temp_df <- data.frame(
             lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
             eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
             eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
             sex = main_df_viable$sex,
             mrsi_age = main_df_viable$sess.age,
             invage = main_df_viable$invage,
             viable = main_df_viable$Viable,
             r_mrs = main_df_viable[[paste0("sipfc.R", roi_from_name(m),"_",currmetabolite,suffix)]],
             l_mrs = main_df_viable[[paste0("sipfc.L", roi_from_name(m),"_",currmetabolite,suffix)]],
             power = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_broadband_",p,"power_",r,"_dB")]]
             )
           # pivot longer and make hemisphere a factor
           temp_df <- temp_df %>% mutate(
             mrs = rowMeans(cbind(r_mrs,l_mrs),na.rm=T) 
           )
           # lm model 
           lm_model <- lm(power ~ invage + mrs + sex,
                          data = temp_df,
                          na.action = na.exclude)
           clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df,
                                              residuals(lm_model),
                                              "lunaid")
           lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(power ~ invage + mrs + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                                        data = clean_df, 
                                        na.action = na.exclude)
           # print summary
           lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
           lmer_coefs <- coef(lmer_summary)
           print(paste(m,p,t,r))
           print(lmer_coefs)
           
           # bundle and save results
           model_bundle <- list(
             model = lmer_model,
             coefs = as.data.frame(lmer_coefs),
             cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
             origdata = lm_model$model
             )
           savename <- paste0("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/R/",t, p, "Power", r, "_", currmetabolite,"_Effect.rds")
           saveRDS(model_bundle,savename)
           
           }
        
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r vgs interaction behavior, echo = FALSE}
clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(main_df_viable,
                                   residuals(lm_model),
                                   "lunaid")
lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(CVLatCor ~ invage*VGS_c5_ersp_interaction_prow + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                             data = clean_df,
                             na.action = na.exclude)
lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
print("VGS P-row cluster 5 and latency variability")
print(lmer_summary)
model_bundle <- list(
  model = lmer_model,
  coefs = as.data.frame(coef(lmer_summary)),
  cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
  origdata = lm_model$model
)
saveRDS(model_bundle,
        "/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/R/CVLatVar_VGSc5prowinteraction.rds")

# cluster 6 and latency variability
```

```{r power ~ age*ersp, echo=FALSE}
tasks <- c("corAS","VGS")

      saveRDS(model_bundle,savename)
    }
  }
}
```

## Behavior
### F-row
```{r behav ~ power*ersp, echo=FALSE}
# variables to loop over
tasks <- c("corAS","VGS")
powertypes <- c("spon","evo")
clusters <- c(1,5)
modelterm <- "interaction"
behavs <- c("CorRate","CVLatCor")

for (t in tasks){
  for (p in powertypes){
    for (C in clusters){
      currcluster <- paste0("cluster",C)
      for (b in behavs){
        temp_df <- data.frame(
          lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
          eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
          eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
          invage = main_df_viable$invage,
          sex = main_df_viable$sex,
          behav = main_df_viable[[b]],
          power = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_broadband_",
                                         p,"power_frow_dB")]],
          ersp = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_c",C,"_ersp_",modelterm,
                                        "_frow")]]
        )
        # run model
        lm_model <- lm(behav ~ power*ersp + invage + sex, 
                       data = temp_df,
                       na.action = na.exclude)
        clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df,
                                           residuals(lm_model),
                                           "lunaid")
        lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(behav ~ power*ersp + invage +sex + 
                                       (1|lunaid_clean),
                                     data = clean_df,
                                     na.action = na.exclude)
        # print results
        lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
        lmer_coefs <- coef(lmer_summary)
        print(paste(t,p,C,b))
        print(lmer_summary)
        
        # save results
        model_bundle <- list(
          model = lmer_model,
          coefs = as.data.frame(lmer_coefs),
          cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
          origdata = lm_model$model
        )
        savename <- paste0("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/R/",
                           b,"_",t,p,"Power",currcluster,"ERSPfrow_Effect.rds")
        saveRDS(model_bundle,savename)
      }
    }
  }
}
```
